newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI nominee to administer CRB Mutual Fund.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI nominee to administer CRB Mutual Fund.

text.p: The Bombay High Court on Tuesday permitted the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to appoint a provisional administrator in charge of CRB Mutual Fund, part of the CRB Group facing liquidation proceedings.
Judge A.Y. Sakhare allowed appointment A.K.Menon as provisional administrator, a SEBI statement said.
SEBI said it had asked called for an emergency meeting of directors of CRB Mutual Fund to find out measures planned to protect the interests of investors in the mutual fund.
"Three of the directors replied that they had already resigned as trustees while the fourth trustee is most likely out of India," SEBI said.
Following this, SEBI moved the court for a direction to appoint an administrator to take charge of the property and assets of the fund and its schemes.
